replies.text: {"verdicts":[{"id":"T1","keep":true,"reason":"Design has stored rich-text comments rendered to every visitor; concrete stored XSS attack."},{"id":"T2","keep":true,"reason":"Link posting on public pages and manual moderator deletion are named; spam flooding is specific."},{"id":"T3","keep":true,"reason":"Delete action named; missing authorization lets any customer delete comments site-wide."},{"id":"T4","keep":true,"reason":"Image embedding in comments named; attacker-controlled URL leaks visitor data — distinct from script execution."},{"id":"T5","keep":true,"reason":"CSRF on named post and delete endpoints is a distinct attack with victim-attributed actions."},{"id":"T6","keep":true,"reason":"Separate harm: script in moderator's privileged admin session abuses moderation powers; needs own fix."},{"id":"T7","keep":true,"reason":"Design names moderator deletion action; missing deletion record is specific accountability gap."}]}
